name: Blue Hawaii Aniki's Soft Ore Demand vol.3
source:
A late-night TV variety show, broadcast (allegedly) to all 7 billion people on Earth.

The long-awaited vol.3 of Blue Hawaii Aniki's Soft Ore-Demand.

A trashy, low-budget late-night variety program starring the self-proclaimed film director "Blue Hawaii Aniki" — a man who, for reasons no one questions, wears shaved ice on his head. This time, the themes are June brides and the summer about to begin.

A burnt-out office worker and a carefree college girl who meet on a grey, colorless beach. A "Working Adult Reskilling Academy" where grown-ups who learned nothing in their school years go back to relive their youth. A mysterious neighbor who only ever appears in a yellow bath towel. And the hopeless romantic struggles of "F4," the four guys sinking at the very bottom of a third-rate university.

The quiet despair of working life, the harsh reality of marriage as a life event, meetings that never end — this is a visual novel that wraps everything we all secretly feel about life's helplessness in a layer of comedy and warmth.

Featured Segments

Newlywed Cooking — A new wife's home cooking, and the story of how they met

Reskilling Academy for Working Adults  — A school where adults "relearn" the youth they missed

Busside Stroll — A beautiful woman in a yellow bath towel, and a walk we don't take

Sleeping in a Row — Sweet moments between a third-rate college student and his beloved

For everyone who laughs, gets a little wistful, and then shoulders the heavy burden of tomorrow all over again.
translation:
一个深夜电视综艺节目，（据称）向地球上所有70亿人播放。

期待已久的Blue Hawaii Aniki软矿石需求第三卷。

一个垃圾、低预算的深夜综艺节目，主演是自称为电影导演的“蓝色夏威夷阿尼基”——一个头上戴着刨冰的男人，没有人质疑他的原因。这次的主题是六月新娘和即将开始的夏天。

一个疲惫不堪的上班族和一个无忧无虑的女大学生在灰色无色的海滩上相遇。一个“在职成人再培训学院”，学生时代没有学到任何东西的成年人可以回去重温他们的青春。只穿着黄色浴巾出现的神秘邻居。还有“F4”无望的爱情斗争，四个人在三流大学的最底层沉沦。

工作生活的平静绝望、婚姻作为生活事件的严酷现实、永无休止的会议——这是一部视觉小说，将我们所有人对生活无助的秘密感受都包裹在一层喜剧和温暖之中。

特色细分市场

新婚烹饪——新婚妻子的家常菜，以及他们如何相遇的故事

在职成人再培训学院 — 成人“重新学习”他们错过的青春的学校

巴士边漫步——裹着黄色浴巾的美女，以及我们不去的散步

连睡——三流大学生与心爱之人的甜蜜时刻

对于每一个笑过的人来说，都会有些许的憧憬，然后又重新肩负起明天的重担。
